text: I need to finalize the schedule and logistics for the upcoming dance competition next month that my studio is hosting to showcase local talent and attract new students. First, I need to coordinate with the participating dance schools to confirm their arrival times, rehearsal slots, and performance order for the big night. I should also organize the panel of judges and send them the official rubric and event timeline. To ensure everything runs smoothly, I will map out a detailed breakdown of the venue setup, sound check schedules, and backstage management for my staff and volunteers. Since I am also focusing on expanding the studio's presence, I need to finalize the promotional flyers and social media announcements for the event, highlighting the guest performances and local dancers. Additionally, if Jon experiences lower back tightness after a heavy day of teaching hip-hop classes, I must remind him to use his TriggerPoint GRID foam roller for fifteen minutes and do a gentle pigeon pose stretch. Finally, I will block out time to prepare my own introductory remarks and make sure all registration details are properly filed so I can welcome Gina and all our guests properly when they arrive for the show.
